Our research group works on gravitational waves, machine learning for science, and theoretical gravity, in close collaboration with computer scientists at the [Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems](https://is.mpg.de/) and the [Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics (AEI)](https://www.aei.mpg.de/).

## Join Us

Our group sits at the intersection of machine learning and gravitational-wave physics, with strong ties to the LVK collaboration, the LISA Consortium, and the ML groups at MPI-IS Tübingen. We are funded by a [UKRI Future Leaders Fellowship](/blog/flf/) (2024--2028) and an STFC Consolidated Grant.

We welcome enquiries from prospective postdocs, PhD students, and visiting researchers. Current interests include simulation-based inference for next-generation detectors, neural waveform modelling, and black hole perturbation theory for LISA sources.

For current opportunities, contact [Stephen Green](mailto:stephen.green2@nottingham.ac.uk).
